mapper.update: update workflow_designs set name=#{name},bpmn_xml=#{bpmnXml},status='DRAFT',revision=revision+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and process_key=#{processKey} and revision=#{revision}

update workflow_designs set status='PUBLISHED',published_definition_id=#{definitionId},published_version=#{version},revision=revision+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{publishedAt},published_at=#{publishedAt} where id=#{id} and revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: select 'USER' type,cast(u.user_id as char) value,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) label,concat(u.user_name,' · ',coalesce(d.dept_name,'未分配部门')) description from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' order by u.user_id
select 'ROLE' type,r.role_key value,r.role_name label,concat('角色标识：',r.role_key) description from sys_role r where r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' order by r.role_sort,r.role_id

select 'DEPT_LEADER' type,cast(d.dept_id as char) value,d.dept_name label,concat('负责人：',coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name)) description from sys_dept d join sys_user u on u.user_name=d.leader and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' where d.status='0' and d.del_flag='0' and d.leader is not null and d.leader<>'' order by d.order_num,d.dept_id
select count(1) from sys_user where cast(user_id as char)=#{userId} and status='0' and del_flag='0'
select count(1) from sys_role where role_key=#{roleKey} and status='0' and del_flag='0'

select cast(u.user_id as char) from sys_dept d join sys_user u on u.user_name=d.leader and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' where cast(d.dept_id as char)=#{deptId} and d.status='0' and d.del_flag='0' limit 1

select cast(leader.user_id as char) from sys_user initiator join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=initiator.dept_id join sys_user leader on leader.user_name=d.leader and leader.status='0' and leader.del_flag='0' where initiator.user_id=#{userId} and initiator.status='0' and initiator.del_flag='0' and d.status='0' and d.del_flag='0' limit 1
select distinct r.role_key from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0'
select coalesce(nullif(nick_name,''),user_name) from sys_user where cast(user_id as char)=#{userId} limit 1
select creator_id from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'
select workflow_engine from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'
select approval_status from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'
select id,process_instance_id,task_id,task_definition_key,action,comment,actor_id,actor_name,created_at from workflow_action_logs where process_instance_id=#{processInstanceId} order by created_at,id
